name: Digital Point Forums

sources.title: Established Members help — signature/link privileges unlock 48h after registration plus 3 'Likes' from existing established members; all member links are nofollow

conditions: Registration is free, but link/signature privileges require 'established member' status: 48 hours after registration AND 3 different existing established members liking a post you wrote
Alternative paid gate: premium membership lets you start sale threads immediately, but still does NOT grant signatures/links early — all member links are nofollow regardless
requirements: Genuine participation expected — asking for Likes publicly or privately gets you banned
Signature links allowed only for established members; affiliate links may be in signatures but not in post bodies; links placed in post bodies as pseudo-signatures are not allowed
Buy/Sell/Trade marketplace threads require established status or premium membership; some areas are premium-only
preparation: A plan for 3+ genuinely useful posts that can earn Likes from established members
A signature link and homepage URL to set once established
workflow: Participate genuinely in relevant forums (SEO, marketing, web development topics) for at least 48 hours
After 3 established-member Likes, the account is promoted (hourly batch process — allow up to an hour)
Set signature + homepage links (all nofollow); post in the marketplace if selling a product/service
watchFor: All user links are nofollow — value is referral/community, not link equity
Directing users to your signature link in posts is prohibited
Site blocks automated fetches (403) — use a normal browser
Forum skews heavily SEO/webmaster — a generic SaaS promo post will read as spam
countsAsLive: Public profile page exists with homepage link set, and/or a marketplace thread is published in Buy, Sell or Trade
unknowns: Premium membership price (help page did not show it)
Whether non-logged-in visitors can see signatures (nofollow regardless)
Current moderation strictness for product announcements outside the marketplace
